infoDescription.en: Configure official plugins and install or manage other plugins here. View the built-in plugin list and runtime status in Settings → Built-in plugins.
infoDescription.zh: 在这里配置官方插件，安装和管理其他插件。内置插件列表及运行状态可在「设置 → 内置插件」中查看

error.en: Could not read all plugins, possibly due to a network problem
error.zh: 可能由于网络问题，无法读取全部插件

unavailable.en: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.
unavailable.zh: 本部署没有可管理的 profile，无法安装或启停插件。

restartNotice.en: The change takes effect at the next start
restartNotice.zh: 更改将在下次启动生效

overriddenNotice.en: {name} was saved, but a higher-priority configuration overrides it, so it is not in effect
overriddenNotice.zh: {name} 已保存，但被更高优先级的配置覆盖，当前未生效

partsEmpty.en: This plugin pack contains no components.
partsEmpty.zh: 这个插件包不包含任何组件。

installDescription.en: Enter the plugin's package name, GitHub repository address, or local directory path.
installDescription.zh: 输入插件的包名、GitHub 仓库地址或本地目录路径。

installGuideIdTitle.en: Enter the plugin's npm package name
installGuideIdTitle.zh: 填入插件 npm 包名

installGuideIdHint.en: The plugin package name is the npm package name (like dsh-xxx or @author/plugin): the part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in a community plugin's README install command.
installGuideIdHint.zh: 插件包名即 npm 包名（如 dsh-xxx 或 @作者/插件名），社区插件的 README 安装命令中 dsh plugin add 或 pnpm add 之后的部分。

installGitTemplateHint.en: Replace this with the actual Git repository address.
installGitTemplateHint.zh: 请替换为实际的 Git 仓库地址

installPathTemplateHint.en: Replace this with the actual path to your local plugin directory.
installPathTemplateHint.zh: 请替换为本机插件目录的实际路径

installGuideSafety.en: Install only plugins you trust: they run with your permissions and can damage DeepSeek Harness or leak your data.
installGuideSafety.zh: 请确认插件来源可信。插件在本机以你的权限运行，来源不明的插件可能损坏 DeepSeek Harness，或读取和泄露你的数据。

installUpgradeNotice.en: Installed plugins do not update automatically yet. To upgrade a plugin, uninstall it and install the new version. Later releases will keep improving the upgrade experience.
installUpgradeNotice.zh: 插件安装后，暂不支持自动更新。若需升级，请先卸载再安装新版，后续版本会持续改善升级体验。

registryLegend.en: The npm registry the plugin is downloaded from
registryLegend.zh: 从哪个 npm 源下载插件

registryCustomHint.en: Enter an internal or private npm registry address starting with http:// or https://. If it requires a login, store the credentials in ~/.npmrc on this machine.
registryCustomHint.zh: 填写内网或私有 npm 源地址，以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。若为需要登录的源，请把凭据放在本机的 ~/.npmrc 里。

registryCustomInvalid.en: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
registryCustomInvalid.zh: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的地址

installProblemInvalid.en: This is not a package name or address that can be installed: {reason}
installProblemInvalid.zh: 无法识别这个包名或地址：{reason}

installProblemInstalled.en: This plugin is already installed. To upgrade it, uninstall it and install it again
installProblemInstalled.zh: 该插件已安装。如需升级，请卸载后重新安装

installProblemShipped.en: This plugin ships with DSH; upgrading DSH updates it
installProblemShipped.zh: 该插件随 DSH 提供，升级 DSH 即可获得新版本

installProblemNotPackage.en: The path does not exist or is not a valid plugin package
installProblemNotPackage.zh: 该路径不存在或不是有效的插件包

installProblemNotBundle.en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be installed as a plugin: {reason}
installProblemNotBundle.zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，无法作为插件安装：{reason}

installProblemNetwork.en: The plugin registry could not be reached; check the network and try again
installProblemNetwork.zh: 无法连接插件源，请检查网络后重试

installProblemNetworkAll.en: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}); check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry
installProblemNetworkAll.zh: 所有安装源都无法连接（已尝试：{registries}），请检查网络或代理设置，或更换安装源

installProblemUnknown.en: The plugin could not be looked up: {reason}

installFailedTitle.en: The plugin could not be installed

installCancelAndEdit.en: Cancel installation and return to editing

installApplyingCancellationError.en: Cancellation was not confirmed. Installation is being applied; wait for its result. {reason}
installApplyingCancellationError.zh: 取消请求未得到确认；安装已进入收尾阶段，请等待结果。{reason}

installUnknownDescription.en: The Host has no active installation with this request id. Check the plugin list before trying again.
installUnknownDescription.zh: 后端当前没有此安装任务。请检查插件列表后再尝试安装。

installResultUnconfirmed.en: The installation result was not received. Check installation status. {reason}
installResultUnconfirmed.zh: 未收到安装结果，请核对安装状态。{reason}

installAwaitingAcceptance.en: Waiting for the Host to accept installation. Cancellation will retry automatically after confirmation.
installAwaitingAcceptance.zh: 正在等待后端接收安装任务，收到确认后会自动重试取消。

installBackgroundUnknown.en: Installation result unavailable. Check the plugin list.
installBackgroundUnknown.zh: 未能获取安装结果，请检查插件列表。

installBackgroundDone.zh: 插件安装已完成，可查看安装结果。

installBackgroundFailed.zh: 插件安装失败，可查看安装详情。

installBackgroundUnconfirmed.en: Installation status is unconfirmed. View the installation for details.
installBackgroundUnconfirmed.zh: 安装状态暂未确认，请查看安装任务了解详情。

installBackgroundApplying.en: Installation is being applied and cannot be cancelled. View installation progress.
installBackgroundApplying.zh: 安装已进入收尾阶段，无法取消，可查看安装进度。

installCancelled.en: Installation cancelled; the plugin is not enabled, and downloaded files may remain
installCancelled.zh: 已取消安装，插件未启用，下载的文件可能保留

installCancelUnconfirmed.en: Installation has not been confirmed stopped. Retry cancellation or wait for the installation result. {reason}
installCancelUnconfirmed.zh: 尚未确认安装已停止，请重试取消或等待安装结果。{reason}

installAttempt.en: {previous} could not serve the package; retrying through {registry} (registry {index} of {total})
installAttempt.zh: {previous} 不可用，正在改用 {registry} 重试（第 {index} 个源，共 {total} 个）

installFailureNetworkAll.en: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}). Check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry and retry.
installFailureNetworkAll.zh: 所有安装源都无法连接（已尝试：{registries}）。请检查网络或代理设置，或更换安装源后重试。

installFailureNetworkHost.en: {host} could not be reached. A GitHub address or a .tgz link is not fetched through the registry: this machine must reach it directly or through a proxy. If the plugin is also published to npm, enter its package name instead.
installFailureNetworkHost.zh: 无法连接 {host}。GitHub 地址和 .tgz 直链不经过安装源，需要本机能直接访问它或配置代理；如果这个插件也发布到了 npm，请改填包名。

installFailureDiskFull.en: The disk is full; the install stopped
installFailureDiskFull.zh: 磁盘空间不足，安装已停止

installFailurePermission.en: No write permission; the plugin cannot be installed
installFailurePermission.zh: 没有写入权限，无法安装

installFailureBuildBlocked.en: A dependency's install scripts need your permission before the install can continue
installFailureBuildBlocked.zh: 有依赖的安装脚本需要你允许后才能继续

installFailureBuildBlockedManual.en: pnpm blocked install scripts; allow them under allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml and retry
installFailureBuildBlockedManual.zh: 有依赖的安装脚本被 pnpm 拦下，请在 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 allowBuilds 中放行后重试

installFailureIntegrity.en: The downloaded package failed its integrity check
installFailureIntegrity.zh: 下载的安装包校验失败

installFailurePnpmMissing.en: pnpm was not found, so nothing can be installed
installFailurePnpmMissing.zh: 没有找到 pnpm，无法安装

installFailureGeneric.en: Something went wrong during the install; the details say what
installFailureGeneric.zh: 安装过程中出错，原因见安装详情

installDoneNothing.en: Install finished with no new dependency.
installDoneNothing.zh: 安装完成，没有新增依赖。

installDoneRestart.en: Installed; it loads at the next start.
installDoneRestart.zh: 已安装，下次启动后加载。

installApprovalDescription.en: These packages have install scripts that pnpm did not run.
installApprovalDescription.zh: 以下包声明了安装脚本，pnpm 默认不运行。

installApprovalConsequence.en: Once allowed, the scripts run here with your permissions, and the permission is saved in this profile.
installApprovalConsequence.zh: 允许后，脚本会以你的权限在本机运行，授权保存在当前 profile，之后不再询问。

installApprovalCaution.zh: 只在信任这些包时允许。

confirmUninstallDescription.en: What it provides goes away once it is uninstalled.
confirmUninstallDescription.zh: 卸载后它提供的功能会消失。

reasonManagementRequired.en: Plugin management needs it; it cannot be switched off or uninstalled.
reasonManagementRequired.zh: 插件管理所需，不能停用或卸载

reasonUnaddressable.en: The profile patch cannot address this one uniquely.
reasonUnaddressable.zh: 当前 profile 的 patch 无法唯一定位这一项

reasonInvalidSpec.en: Enter a valid package name or address.
reasonInvalidSpec.zh: 请输入有效的包名或地址

reasonAmbiguousInstall.en: Which package was installed cannot be told from the dependency change.
reasonAmbiguousInstall.zh: 无法从依赖变更中确定安装了哪一个包

reasonNotBundle.en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be managed as a plugin.
reasonNotBundle.zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，不能作为插件管理

reasonNotRemovable.en: This package is not owned by the profile, or plugin management needs it.
reasonNotRemovable.zh: 这个包不属于当前 profile，或者是插件管理所需的组件

reasonStopProfile.en: This profile runs without HMR; stop it and uninstall the package with dsh plugin.
reasonStopProfile.zh: 这个 profile 没有启用 HMR，正在使用的包要停止后用 dsh plugin 卸载

reasonBundleInUse.en: Other configuration still uses this bundle's components; switch them off first.
reasonBundleInUse.zh: 其他配置仍在使用这个组合包的组件，请先停用它们

reasonStaleApproval.en: The pending script approvals changed; install again to refresh them.
reasonStaleApproval.zh: 待允许的安装脚本列表已变化，请重新安装以刷新

reasonIncompatibleVersion.en: {plugin} is incompatible with DSH {runtime} (requires {peers}); running it may cause crashes or data loss.
reasonIncompatibleVersion.zh: {plugin} 与 DSH {runtime} 不兼容（要求 {peers}），运行它可能导致崩溃或数据丢失。

reasonIncompatibleVersionUnnamed.en: This plugin is incompatible with the running DSH version; running it may cause crashes or data loss.
reasonIncompatibleVersionUnnamed.zh: 这个插件与当前 DSH 版本不兼容，运行它可能导致崩溃或数据丢失。

reasonIncompatibleInstall.en: Install a plugin version compatible with this DSH.
reasonIncompatibleInstall.zh: 请安装与当前 DSH 兼容的插件版本。

reasonIncompatibleInstalled.en: Uninstall it and install a version compatible with this DSH.
reasonIncompatibleInstalled.zh: 请卸载后重新安装与当前 DSH 兼容的版本。
